Projects.Title: Yugen Mosaic
Projects.Caption: Photo & video
Projects.Description: Yugen Mosaic is a free app that creates digital art pictures based on your own images. With it, you can use an unlimited amount of images, to create a photo mosaic which is an image composed of many tiled photos. or you can create some "Ascii" "Art", this graphic design technique will recreate your pictures with a set of printable characters pieced together. Yugen is an awareness of the universe that triggers emotional responses too deep and powerful for words, and that is just what your art will do with a little help from Yugen Mosaic!

Links.Description: Open Yugen Mosaic in the Microsoft Store
Open Yugen Mosaic repo on GitHub.

Projects.Title: Links Catalog
Projects.Caption: Utilities & tools
Projects.Description: Links Catalog is a clean, modern app for saving, organizing, and revisiting the links that matter to you. Built natively for Windows 11 (with native ARM64 support), it turns scattered bookmarks into a well-organized personal catalog./nGroup your links into collections, sort them by category, and find anything instantly with full-text search across all your links. Every link can show a rich web preview generated from the page itself, so your catalog is visual and easy to scan rather than a plain list of URLs.

Links.Description: Open Links Catalog in the Microsoft Store
